visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a pink-haired plush doll wearing a white t-shirt and blue shorts, secured by a car seatbelt against a black leather seat. The lighting is bright and even. (2) A woman with brown hair tied back, wearing a white off-the-shoulder top and a white unbuttoned shirt, holds the plush doll while walking through an outdoor urban plaza with green bushes and skyscrapers in the background. Passers-by are visible. (3) The scene shifts to the woman walking through a subway or transport station with grey floors and pillars, holding the doll. (4) The woman is seen through a glass door or mirror, filming herself with a smartphone while holding the doll; she has a yellow headband. (5) Inside a crowded exhibition hall, the woman interacts with a man wearing a white t-shirt and a grey baseball cap. She holds the plush doll up to him, and he smiles broadly, gesturing towards the doll. There are yellow and white banners with cartoon characters in the background. (6) A person's hand holds the doll as it 'kisses' a large yellow egg-shaped mascot character. The woman laughs and smiles in the background. (7) A montage of close-ups follows, showing various merchandise at a booth labeled 'SHAOGAO', including yellow pillows, tote bags, pins, notebooks, and phone cases with cartoon illustrations. The lighting is bright studio style. (8) The woman takes a mirror selfie with the doll, then a close-up shows the doll sitting on a white plastic chair in an auditorium with people seated in the background. (9) The final phase features the woman, the man in the cap, and another woman with bright pink hair standing in front of a yellow cartoon-themed wall. They wave, make peace signs, and point at the doll while talking enthusiastically to the camera.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Scenes transition from a car interior to a bright outdoor walkway with modern buildings, a clean subway station, and finally a bustling exhibition hall (Nangang Exhibition Center) filled with yellow-themed cartoon booths and merchandise displays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop track with a strong synth bassline and female English vocals. The female narrator speaks in an excited, high-pitched tone, her speech rapid. (2) As the scene transitions to the station, a subtle 'pop' SFX is heard. The narrator's voice maintains high energy. (3) Upon entering the exhibition hall, background chatter and muffled laughter become audible, layered beneath the loud BGM. The narrator greets someone, her pitch rising further. (4) A male voice enters the mix, sounding friendly and surprised, laughing slightly. A 'mwah' kissing SFX is added during the doll's interaction with the mascot. (5) During the merchandise montage, the speech density drops, allowing the BGM to become more prominent. Soft digital 'ding' effects accompany text appearing on screen. (6) In the final phase, three voices (two female, one male) overlap in a joyous, high-arousal farewell, waving and speaking loudly over the continuous driving electronic beat.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Journey -> Event Arrival -> Product Exploration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-energy promotional vlog to invite fans to the 'SHAOGAO' booth at the Creative Expo Taiwan (Nangang Exhibition Center). It uses the 'Beibi' plush doll as a central mascot to create a narrative of 'returning home' to the creator, while showcasing available merchandise and providing specific event logistics.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly names the booth (I-034), shows the specific products (plush dolls, bags, etc.), and features the creator (Shaogao) endorsing the visit.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video employs typical social media short-form editing styles: high-saturation colors, fast cuts synced to an upbeat track, and heavy use of dynamic subtitles to maintain viewer engagement and drive attendance to a physical event.
